senses.gloss: (b. h.) to join; to pile up (cmp. חָמַר I); to collect.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Yoma V, 1</cite> <he>צ׳ את הקטורת וכ׳</he> he heaped the frankincense upon the coals.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:4">Tam. I, 4</cite>. Y. B. Bath. III, beg. 13ᵈ <he>כיון שצ׳ לתוכו וכ׳</he> as soon as he has put into it a pile of fruit, he has taken possession (of the building).

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 11:6">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XI</cite> <he>צ׳ את עפרו וכ׳</he> God collected the dust out of which to create Adam (v. infra); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="R00027"><he>צָבוּר</he></cite>; f. <he>צְבוּרָה</he>; pl. <he>צְבוּרִים</he>, <he>צְבוּרִין</he>; <he>צְבוּרוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1:4">Y. Taan. II, beg. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>רואין … כאילו צ׳ וכ׳</he> we look upon it as if the ashes of Isaac were heaped upon the altar.
<cite ref="Shabbat 127a:3">Sabb. 127ᵃ</cite> <he>תבואה צ׳</he> fruits piled for storage.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 69a:1">B. Bath. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>אבנים צ׳ לגדר</he> stones piled up (but not yet arranged and assorted) to build a fence with, contrad. to <he>סדורות</he> (cmp.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:6">Tosef. ib. III, 6</cite>, quot. s. v. <cite ref="O00411"><he>סָוַר</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to be piled, stored. Y. B. Bath. l. c. פירות ראויין לִיצָּבֵר fruits fit for storage (not only temporarily deposited).

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>אדם … ה׳ עפרו</he> the dust of which Adam was made, was collected from all parts of the world; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b">ib.ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I</cite>.
